subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps

John — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the next steps so we stay aligned:

Pain points you called out:
- Need a narrow retention and audit-logging policy for PII-associated prompts and outputs.
- Must demonstrate SOC 2 controls for data handling and vendor due diligence.
- Procurement requires a redlined DPA + pen test evidence for security gate.

Goals:
- Produce SOC 2 artifact set and an evidence bundle for your security review within two weeks.
- Get procurement the DPA + pricing addendum and target procurement sign-off by 4/5.

What we can provide (next steps from Redwood):
1) Attach: "redwood-soc2-summary.pdf" — high-level SOC 2 scope, system boundaries, and SOC 2 control matrix to map to your checklist.
2) Attach: lightweight pen-test evidence stub (non-sensitive): "redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.txt" showing test scope and remediation status. Full reports are available under NDA; we can coordinate that if you want.
3) Share DPA template: "DPA-template-redwood.docx" for your legal team to redline. We can accept DocuSign once redlines are agreed.
4) Follow-ups: marissa (me) + neha (security engineer) + michael (sales lead) will own the deliverables and timeline.

Proposed timeline:
- By Mon 3/22: Send SOC 2 summary, pen-test stub, and DPA template (we will attach).
- By Fri 4/2: Provide an evidence bundle (audit logs export instructions, retention policy excerpt).
- Week of 4/5: Procurement review + DocuSign target.

If that looks good, I’ll send the files now and schedule a 30-min follow-up for 3/24 to walk through the evidence and next procurement questions.

Thanks again — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.txt; DPA-template-redwood.docx

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com, procure@acme.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A couple of clarifying notes from the security team:

- Retention: we need a configurable retention policy by customer, with an extractable retention report for audit purposes. Can you confirm Redwood supports per-tenant retention windows and how to request exports?
- Audit logs: we require an immutable audit log for administrative actions with tamper-evidence. Can you point to how audit logs are stored and any retention you recommend?
- Pen test: good to know full reports need NDA. Please include an executive summary we can share with procurement without the NDA so we can progress contracting.

Procurement note: we’ll circulate the DPA to legal. Can you also include a proposed SSO + SCIM integration plan and expected timeline to onboard? That will help us scope the procurement effort.

Appreciate the timeline — 3/22 deliverables would be great.

—
John
Head of Security Operations, Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps

John — great questions, answers below and I’ve attached the requested items for procurement to start: DPA template + SOC 2 summary + pen test executive summary (attached as the stub).

- Retention per-tenant: Yes. Redwood supports per-customer retention policies (configurable retention windows in the Console). For audit purposes we can generate an export of retained records by customer and timeframe — typically a CSV export via our support portal; we will include step-by-step export instructions in the evidence bundle.

- Audit logs: Administrative actions are captured in an append-only audit log stored in our KMS-backed logging store with write-once retention settings. We produce tamper-evidence hashes for each log file rotation. I’ve included a short Audit Logs FAQ in the SOC 2 summary that outlines storage, rotation cadence, and retention recommendations.

- Pen test executive summary: attached as part of "redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.txt". Full remediation artifacts and the full pen test report are available under NDA; I’ve added the sample language procurement can use to request the report.

- SSO + SCIM onboarding: Redwood supports SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning. Typical onboarding takes 1–2 weeks depending on customer IAM capacity. I’ve included the onboarding checklist link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-soc2-evidence

Next actions we’ll take today (3/22):
- Deliverables (done): attach SOC 2 summary, DPA template, pen-test executive summary.
- Schedule: I’ll send a calendar invite for 3/24 10:00am PT to walk through the artifacts.

If procurement/legal want us to accept a requested redline, we can review the DPA and provide a redline response within 2 business days after we receive it.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; redwood-pen-test-evidence-stub.txt; DPA-template-redwood.docx
